wakemed_network_termination.implication_for_well_spring: Any Alliance Health Tailored Plan-enrolled child/adolescent receiving services at Well Spring who requires emergency psychiatric hospitalization CANNOT be transferred to WakeMed after July 1, 2026 (out-of-network). Alternative in-network hospitals: UNC Medical Center / UNC Rex Hospital (Raleigh) and Duke Health (Duke Raleigh Hospital / Duke University Hospital) — both remain in-network with Alliance Health Tailored Plan per Duke Health 2026 Accepted Health Insurance Plans list.

critical_2026_update.alliance_2024_partnership_with_wakemed_r: Wake County and Alliance Health had a 2023 partnership with WakeMed to operate a 28-bed inpatient behavioral health facility (announced October 24, 2023). However, this does not extend to general Tailored Plan network status, which terminates July 1, 2026.
